newsitem.title: USA: CME August pork bellies jump 3.00 cent limit.
newsitem.headline: CME August pork bellies jump 3.00 cent limit.

text.p: CME August pork bellies rose the 3.00 cent per lb daily limit in reaction to steady to higher cash prices Thursday, traders said.
USDA reported cash bellies traded steady to $2.00 per cwt higher Thursday, with 12- to -14-lb portions trading from $90.00 to $92.00 per cwt versus $90.00 late Wednesday.
Traders estimated about 100 contracts were bid limit up in the August. CME August pork belly futures were at 85.425 cents per lb, while July rose 2.50 cents to 88.100.
